data.name: Niketa
data.gender_notes: Niketa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niketana', meaning 'bringing victory' or 'victorious'. In Hindu mythology, Niketa is a name for the goddess Durga, symbolizing the victory of good over evil. The name Niketa carries the meaning “Victory Bringer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Niketa usually hope their child will grow to embody victory bringer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, courage, and victory in the face of challenges.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niketa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
